module: Flowgraph node "Message" (category once_instant by default, duration): displays a message in the small messages app via the 'Message' hook. Inputs: flow, "message" (any; nil clears), "duration" (5 s), "category" (flowgraph; only one message per category), "icon" (info, hidden). Output: flow.
notes: The message is resent every 0.05 s while the flow is active, to stay displayed.
Without a category, the identifier '__<node id>' is used.

_afterTrigger.desc: Resets the timer to 0 if the input flow is cut.

_executionStarted.desc: Resets the timer to 0 and prepares the default category.

work.desc: Periodically resends the message to the UI and propagates the flow.
